name: Skill Summary
query:
SELECT
    `tabAI Skill`.name AS "Skill ID:Data:140",
    `tabAI Skill`.skill_name AS "Skill Name:Data:200",
    `tabAI Skill`.skill_type AS "Type:Data:100",
    `tabAI Skill`.scope AS "Scope:Data:80",
    `tabAI Skill`.scope_value AS "Scope Value:Data:120",
    `tabAI Skill`.enabled AS "Enabled:Check:60",
    `tabAI Skill`.version AS "Version:Int:60",
    `tabAI Skill`.usage_count AS "Used:Int:60",
    `tabAI Skill`.source_user AS "Source User:Link/User:120",
    `tabAI Skill`.description AS "Description:Small Text:250",
    `tabAI Skill`.creation AS "Created:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabAI Skill`
ORDER BY
    `tabAI Skill`.usage_count DESC, `tabAI Skill`.creation DESC
LIMIT 500
